source_documents.title: A Computational Protocol to Predict Anti-Kasha Emissions: The Case of Azulene Derivatives

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1c / 1,3-dichloroazulene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1; ADC(2) in parentheses; experimental 0-0 energies in 3-methylpentane.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ADC(2) S1/S2 0-0 energies are 1.55/3.45 eV versus cited experiment 1.59/3.35 eV; S2 vertical oscillator strength is 0.058.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Energies/oscillator strengths belong to the individual row; chemical graph not confirmed.

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F052 TVCF model at 298 K; gas-phase PBE0/6-31G(d) geometries/frequencies and ADC(2)/def2-TZVP energies/dipoles. Table 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed S1 kr=1.5 x10^6 and kIC=7.8 x10^11 s^-1; S2 kr=2.5 x10^7 and kIC to S1=1.7 x10^9 s^-1. S2 yield is 1.5%, S1 yield 1.9 x10^-4%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculated rates and quantum yields, not new measurements; coupling/harmonic approximations apply.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Experimental data are averaged values from ref. 33 (b), ref. 34 (c) and ref. 81 (d), respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1c external experimental values
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2 visually inspected; external references compiled in F052.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compiled S2 yield is 5.0 +/-0.9%, kr=3.6 +/-0.1 x10^7 s^-1 and nonradiative rate 7.0 +/-1.2 x10^8 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Original experimental papers not personally inspected. Computed and compiled values are not identical.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for 1c-d that there is some charge transfer away from the halogen atoms at the 1,3-positions in both S1 and S2.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1c and 1d
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main account of electron-density-difference maps, SI Figure S4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors report some halogen-to-framework charge redistribution in both S1 and S2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Weak explicit CT character only; no pure CT state, TICT geometry or separate PET event demonstrated. SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: when comparing 1a and 1d, or 1b and 1e, they have almost the same S2-S1 adiabatic energy gap, but still a significantly different rate.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1a-1e including 1c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Rate versus gap and total reorganization energy comparison.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors attribute rate differences at comparable gaps to nonadiabatic coupling/reorganization energies, not the gap alone.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Cited pair example applies directly to 1d; for 1c the p22 comparison with 1a likewise shows larger gap need not mean slower IC.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for 1b, 1c and 1d, the presence of heavy-atom substituents at the 1,3 positions blocks this low frequency accepting mode
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b-1d including 1c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Normal-mode analysis, Figure 6; low-frequency hydrogen bending and high-frequency central-bond stretch.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Substitution reduces the approximately 850 cm^-1 contribution; central C9-C10 stretching near 1450 cm^-1 remains important for 1c/1d and total reorganization energy is higher than 1a.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not a physical confinement experiment. Mode-specific suppression coexists with faster overall IC and does not establish enhanced emission by RIM.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for azulene derivatives, intersystem crossing processes among other possible non-radiative decay pathways are not relevant.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1a-1e, including 1c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Model pathway selection based on earlier experimental literature.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC is neglected and singlet radiative/internal-conversion channels dominate the model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model assumption grounded in cited work, not a newly measured zero ISC; heavy atoms do not automatically justify a triplet label.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence yield from S2 is at least 1500 times larger than the yield from S1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1a-1e, including 1c
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F052 TVCF model at 298 K; gas-phase PBE0/6-31G(d) geometries/frequencies and ADC(2)/def2-TZVP energies/dipoles.
reference_evidence_units.statement: All studied derivatives are predicted to have appreciable S2 but negligible S1 fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparative prediction, not equality of individual rates/yields. S1 emission is extremely small, not mathematically zero.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain explicitly calculated, limited halogen-to-framework CT character as a secondary interpretation, not a dominant pure CT mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Individual radiative/IC rates and reorganization-energy dependence support state/rate competition with numerical uncertainty.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source predicts dominant S2 anti-Kasha emission and compares to external fluorescence data.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Selective accepting-mode blocking is reported but does not establish restriction-driven overall enhancement or aggregation RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain explicitly calculated, limited halogen-to-framework CT character as a secondary interpretation, not a dominant pure CT mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Individual radiative/IC rates and reorganization-energy dependence support state/rate competition with numerical uncertainty.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Heavy atoms are present but ISC is neglected in this source's model; no positive triplet pathway established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established for this target in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source predicts dominant S2 anti-Kasha emission and compares to external fluorescence data.
